First, I need to identify which rider had the most points from the 1999 Dutch TT race. The table lists riders from position 1 to 24, plus some who retired (Ret). Points are given in the "Points" column, with the winner getting 25 points, second place 20, and so on down to 15th place getting 1 point. Positions 16 and below (including retirees) have no points listed (empty or blank).

Looking at the table:
- Position 1: Loris Capirossi – 25 points
- Position 2: Valentino Rossi – 20 points
- Position 3: Jeremy McWilliams – 16 points
- Position 4: Tohru Ukawa – 13 points
- Position 5: Shinya Nakano – 11 points
- Position 6: Ralf Waldmann – 10 points
- Position 7: Franco Battaini – 9 points
- Position 8: Stefano Perugini – 8 points
- Position 9: Jason Vincent – 7 points
- Position 10: Anthony West – 6 points
- Position 11: Alex Hofmann – 5 points
- Position 12: Sebastian Porto – 4 points
- Position 13: Tomomi Manako – 3 points
- Position 14: Masaki Tokudome – 2 points
- Position 15: Jarno Janssen – 1 point
- Positions 16 to 24 and retirees have no points (empty or blank in the Points column).

The highest points value is 25, which belongs to Loris Capirossi. No other rider has more than 25 points.

Final Answer: Loris Capirossi
